# MARK — Japan Fixer（日本中文 Fixer）

> MARK is a Chinese-speaking fixer who has lived in Japan for 20 years. He helps overseas film, TV and brand crews shoot in Japan, working in Chinese and Japanese.

## Services
- Location scouting and filming permits (local governments, facilities, owners)
- Interview access and arrangements (hospitals, research institutes, companies, craftspeople, local residents)
- On-site interpreting, Chinese ⇄ Japanese
- Production coordination: schedules, transport, accommodation, meals, equipment rental, local crew
- Pre-production research
- Cultural navigation and on-set problem solving

## Selected work
- Medical Elite: Regenerative Medicine（醫療先鋒：再生醫學）— Discovery, 2024. Medical documentary. New York Festivals TV & Film Awards 2026, Documentary, Finalist. Full episode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JxVk7_Kpvt0
- Camping in the Corners of the World（在世界的角落紮營）— Mediacorp (Singapore), 2026. Outdoor travel TV programme.
- furrmacy UAE Promotional Film — furrmacy, 2026. Filming in a pharmaceutical factory clean room, plus R&D and medical interviews.
